page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr6.20xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance configured with 80 vCPUs and 768.0 GB of system memory. Powered by the KVM hypervisor, this instance runs on the x86_64 architecture using Intel Xeon 8269CY processors operating at a clock speed of 3.1 GHz. The CPU allocation is dedicated, featuring 80 physical cores with 1.0 thread per core, which ensures consistent compute performance by avoiding hyperthreading overhead.

This instance does not include local storage, requiring external block storage volumes for persistent data. It features a baseline network bandwidth of 25 Gbps to support data transfer requirements. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 9.6 GB per core positions this instance as a resource-dense option for workloads requiring substantial memory footprints without the overhead of local storage arrays.

The ecs.hfr6.20xlarge is designed for memory-intensive enterprise workloads. Suitable use cases include large-scale in-memory databases, caching layers, enterprise resource planning systems, and memory-bound data processing applications that benefit from dedicated physical cores and high memory capacity.
